messages:
maya (support): ACME reported intermittent invalid JSON errors from streaming 'jsonmode' responses when using gzip compression + client reconnects. they see parse failures on our SDKs
acme_integration: stack trace + short log: 
```
recv: b'...\n{"type":"response","payload":{\"text\":\"hello\"}\n'  # note missing closing brace on chunk
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 45 (char 44)
```
jin (py-sdk): hmm, looks like chunk boundary split mid-object during gzip decompress. which SDK version?
lena (ts-sdk): ACME says they're on ts-sdk 0.9.1 and py-sdk 1.2.0, running through a custom proxy that does streaming + gzip.
sam (engineer): two quick asks: 1) can acme share full raw bytes for a failing stream? 2) which endpoint and model?
acme_integration: sending raw capture via DM (pasted to orig thread): `gzipped stream -> client reconnect -> onResume we get fragment starting with '"payload":{\"text\":\"hi'` then chunk ends`
maya (support): reproducer attempt: we tried to replay with ts-sdk 0.9.1 + gzip and saw a JSON decode at random boundaries.
jin (py-sdk): py-sdk uses incremental decoder + relies on PDUs separated by `\n` in jsonmode. gzip + proxy may be stripping newlines or coalescing frames. can you attach a hexdump?
sam (engineer): ops-bot, any recent infra changes to streaming encoding or proxies around that customer region?
ops-bot: deploy 2026-11-12T03:14 -> no streaming-encoding changes. proxy team rolled out chunked-encoding optimization 2026-11-10.
lena (ts-sdk): TS incremental parser expects NDJSON boundaries; if gzip decompression yields concatenated fragments without final newline, the parser waits; but reconnect/resume may produce an initial fragment that begins mid-object. need to ensure server sends full object boundaries or we implement a robust resync.
jin (py-sdk): propose: 1) add tolerant reassembly mode: try to detect partial JSON start and buffer until closing brace, with a small max buffer; 2) add debug flag to log raw frames before parser.
sam (engineer): agree. short-term: ask ACME to disable proxy gzip, confirm if issue stops. long-term: add heuristics in SDKs and add server-side heartbeat/newline after each NDJSON object.
maya (support): ACME confirmed disabling gzip reduces errors. they're OK to test SDK patch but asked for ETA.
sam (engineer): i'll spin up a minimal repro in lab using their capture and the three SDKs (py/ts/go) today. jin/lena, can you review a small PR for tolerant reassembly? target ship in next patch within 48h if no regressions.
jin (py-sdk): will open PR with `--jsonmode-tolerant` flag and debug logging.
lena (ts-sdk): will add similar option and a small stateful resync function.
acme_integration: thx team, will validate once you ping. appreciate quick triage. :pray:
maya (support): i've logged an internal incident and assigned to eng-runtime for follow-up: INC-20031. will update ACME when PRs are ready.
sam (engineer): action items: reproduce -> PRs -> extended CI with gzipped proxy replay -> release patch. closing thread when rollouts complete.
